programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case): On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. This mother, married to a supermarket boss, made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that shortly after midnight, some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept. Who could have despised Richard Alessandri enough to kill him in cold blood in his own bed? Was he the victim of a robbery gone wrong, as claimed by his wife?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Dire Deception (LAURENCE MAILLE CASE): On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned. An unprecedented search was immediately launched to try to find her. Beautiful, intelligent and generous, Laurence Maille had everything to be happy about and for 18 months, had found the perfect love in her partner.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Mystery of Room 602 (Véronique Pirotton Case): On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had just found her unconscious on the bathroom floor with a mysterious plastic bag next to her. Despite the emergency rescue response, Véronique Pirotton died a few minutes later.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case) - On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up. In this astonishing case, the clues examined by the experts will give them two leads: two men, two suspects with very different profiles... but investigators are convinced that they both have a direct link with the murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: THE CASE OF STÉPHANE KAMEUGNE - On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school. A theory soon emerged: the very drunk student had fallen over thea bridge over the canal which led to his death. But his parents and relatives did not believe this.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: The Song of Names
programme.desc: Martin Simmonds has been haunted throughout his life by the mysterious disappearance of his "brother" and extraordinary best friend, a Polish Jewish virtuoso violinist, Dovidl Rapaport, who vanished shortly before his 1951 London debut concert.

programme.title: Addition
programme.desc: Grace counts everything because numbers hold her world together, but a chance encounter with Seamus unravels her meticulously ordered life.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Rex is based on the true-life story of young Marine Corporal Megan Leavey whose unique discipline and bond with her military combat dog saved many lives during their deployment in Iraq.

programme.title: Emperor
programme.desc: Emperor, the son of an African king and a slave on an American plantation, can no longer tolerate the atrocities committed by whites against blacks.

programme.title: Gook
programme.desc: Eli and Daniel, two Korean American brothers, own a struggling shoe store and have an unlikely friendship with Kamilla, a street wise 11-year-old African American girl. Kamilla ditches school, Eli stresses about the store, and Daniel tries to have a good time.

programme.title: Motherland
programme.desc: In an alternate society where the state frees parents from the burden of raising children, a rule enforcer learns a shocking truth that sparks her rebellion.

programme.title: The Buddy Holly Story
programme.desc: Buddy Holly laid the foundations for a generation of popular music with his ground-breaking combination of country music and rhythm & blues.

programme.title: Life at These Speeds
programme.desc: After a teenager's friends are killed in an accident, he finds running allows him to remember them perfectly. Running, however, also brings him notoriety. Soon he finds himself caught between keeping the past alive and making new memories in the present.

programme.title: East of the Mountains
programme.desc: A retired heart surgeon with terminal cancer sets out on a final journey with his dog to his childhood home. When plans unravel, he’s pulled into an unexpected adventure, facing life with wit, resilience, and a renewed sense of purpose.

programme.title: On a Wing and a Prayer
programme.desc: In this extraordinary true story of faith and survival, "On A Wing and A Prayer" follows passenger Doug White’s (Dennis Quaid) harrowing journey to safely land a plane and save his entire family from insurmountable danger after their pilot dies unexpectedly mid-flight. Heather Graham also stars.

programme.title: Bee Season
programme.desc: Richard Gere stars in this gripping tale about a father obsessed with training his talented daughter for the National Spelling Bee.

programme.title: Ithaca
programme.desc: When his older brother leaves to fight in WWII, 14-year-old Homer Macauley takes a job as a bicycle messenger to provide for his widowed mother and siblings.

programme.title: The Ark
programme.desc: The Ark is a retelling of the biblical story of Noah and The Ark. Noah, a farmer and family man, is instructed by an angel to build an ark in the middle of a desert in order to save both his family and the faithful from a devastating flood.

programme.title: Hope Gap
programme.desc: Annette Bening, Bill Nighy and Josh O’Connor shine in William Nicholson’s intimate portrait of a family crisis.

programme.title: After The Wedding
programme.desc: Isabel (Michelle Williams) has devoted her life to running an orphanage in a Kolkata slum. With funds running dry, she lands uncomfortably in the sights of a possible benefactor, Theresa Young (Julianne Moore), a multi-millionaire media mogul. Theresa's life couldn't appear to be more perfect.

programme.title: When We Get There
programme.desc: Two brothers set out on a 2,000-mile road trip to find their father, confronting uncertain futures, fragile relationships and the meaning of family along the way.

programme.title: Half of a Yellow Sun
programme.desc: Chiwetel Ejiofor (12 Years A Slave, Children of Men) and Thandie Newton (Crash, The Pursuit of Happyness) star in this epic chronicle of family ties and war from celebrated Nigerian playwright Biyi Bandele.

programme.title: Grace and Grit
programme.desc: A couple's marriage is shaken by the discovery of an illness. Together they will fight to make sense of this struggle and discover the meaning of eternal love.

programme.title: Love and Honor
programme.desc: While fighting in Vietnam, Dalton hears his girlfriend back home has dumped him. He has a week's leave coming up so decides to fly to get her back. AWOL from the war zone, he has seven days to get back to the US, change his girlfriend's mind and make it back to Vietnam without anyone noticing.

programme.title: The Man Without a Face
programme.desc: A drama film about a young boy who befriends a disfigured recluse in a small coastal town; and helps him overcome his fear of society and confront his past.

programme.title: Please Stand By
programme.desc: A young autistic woman runs away from her caregiver to boldly go and deliver her 500-page Star Trek script to a writing competition in Hollywood. On an adventure full of laughter and tears, Wendy follows the guiding spirit of Mr. Spock on her journey into the unknown.

programme.title: I Can Only Imagine
programme.desc: It's the song that brings ultimate hope to so many...often in the midst of life s most challenging moments.

programme.title: The Martini Shot
programme.desc: This existential comedy follows an ailing movie director as he shoots what he believes to be his final work of art. What starts out as a normal movie, ends up being an exploration of mortality and one's profound effect on the world.

programme.title: The Great Alaskan Race
programme.desc: During a deadly 1925 outbreak in Alaska, musher Leonhard must cross 700 miles of brutal terrain to deliver life-saving serum. With his son’s life at stake, he relies on his sled dogs in a race against time inspired by a true story.

programme.title: Surprised by Oxford
programme.desc: Caro, a brilliant but emotionally guarded American student, arrives at the prestigious Oxford University with the sole focus of attaining her PhD.

programme.title: A Hologram for the King
programme.desc: A Hologram for the King follows businessman Alan Clay (Tom Hanks) on a journey halfway around the world, far from his American roots, to a rising Saudi Arabian city.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: In the wake of a painful estrangement from his daughter, boxing trainer Frankie Dunn has been unwilling to let himself get close to anyone for a very long time – then Maggie Fitzgerald walks into his gym.

programme.title: The Slaughter Rule
programme.desc: A young man finds solace with a young woman, his mother, and a high-school football coach who recruits him to quarterback a six-man team.

programme.title: Stonewall
programme.desc: As Danny and his friends experience discrimination, endure atrocities and are repeatedly harassed by the police, we see a rage begin to build.

programme.desc: John and Aeryn avoid getting sucked into an unstable wormhole while flying his ship near a high flare sun.

programme.title: The Flax
programme.desc: Aeryn takes Crichton out in a transport pod for flying lessons but they get stuck in the Flax, a space trap.

programme.title: Rhapsody In Blue
programme.desc: Z'han joins her own people, but one of them wants something from her and will do almost anything to take it.

programme.title: Jeremiah Crichton
programme.desc: Crichton is left behind in Farscape One when Moya suddenly starbursts as a result of her pregnancy.

programme.title: Durka Returns
programme.desc: Moya collides with a Nebari ship. Durka is on board and has been mind cleansed. He now serves the Nebari.

programme.title: A Human Reaction
programme.desc: Moya travels through an unstable wormhole that appears to lead to Earth.

programme.title: Through The Looking Glass
programme.desc: Moya tries to starburst to prove herself but it goes wrong when she gets split into several dimensions.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: A peacekeeper ship approaches Moya, so Crichton and Aeryn pose as peacekeeper officers on a secret mission.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Aeryn has been critically wounded. She needs some tissue samples to heal. The only source is the Secret base.

programme.title: The Hidden Memory
programme.desc: Scorpius attempts to extract the wormhole technology from Crichton's mind. Aeryn mounts a rescue operation.

programme.title: Bone To Be Wild
programme.desc: The crew find a planetoid that's a paradise occupied by a scientist and a girl. But one is a killer.

programme.title: Family Ties
programme.desc: Moya's crew say their final goodbyes and share a last feast together, before trying to save Moya and her baby.

programme.title: Mind The Baby
programme.desc: Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them.

programme.title: Vitas Mortis
programme.desc: D'Argo does a sacred ritual to help an old Luxan survive. He draws energy from Moya making her age rapidly.

programme.title: Taking The Stone
programme.desc: Chiana leaves Moya and goes to 'grave planet' populated by thrill seekers who play life threatening games.

programme.title: Crackers Don't Matter
programme.desc: A visitor comes on Moya with a device that could cloak Moya and everyone starts acting paranoid.

programme.title: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Chiana finds a recording with Moya's prior Pilot. Pilot orders Aeryn to leave after realizing she was there.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Six Black men had been brutally murdered; two had their hearts cut out. The only thing connecting the victims was their ethnicity and the fact that each had been shot with .22 caliber bullets.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1990, a 14-year-old girl ran away from her Texas home and disappeared; six months later, her body was found hundreds of miles away in an Illinois barn. Agents tracked down a trucker who they believed was responsible for over 50 murders.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: After a young woman went missing, police suspected that her well-connected, married ex-lover was responsible.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Powerful street gangs in Washington D.C. enforced their power with deadly violence. The gang leader had fled to Africa, a hunt that ended in the 1994 Washington D.C. Metropolitan Police Headquarters shootout.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Masked bandits pulled off a daring bank robbery in the middle of the day. Without any evidence, FBI agents had to force their own luck in the four-year manhunt for the so-called "Hollywood" bank robber in Seattle, Washington.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When authorities in a small Washington town began investigating the disappearance of a young woman, they had no idea it would turn into a nationwide hunt for a sadistic sexual predator. The FBI was called in to help track down Darren Dee O'Neall.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A stranger snatched an 8-year-old girl as she played in her Tucson, Arizona neighborhood. Within hours, police began to suspect a drifter who was out on parole for abducting and molesting children.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On a cold afternoon in 1989, Marine Captain Shirley Russell failed to report for duty at the base in Quantico, Virginia. FBI agents noticed her husband, a former Marine, was acting strangely. There was no body, no witness and no weapon.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: New Jersey millionaire Frank Black flew to West Palm Beach, Florida to close a major business deal but never returned home. When the FBI was called in, agents learned of a mystery woman whom Black met while on his trip.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1997, the FBI and the NYPD began a joint investigation into gas station mogul Gurmeet Dhinsa for gas pump rigging. However, they soon realized Dhinsa ruled his mob-like operation with brutal force, kidnapping and killing wayward employees.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The decapitation of an African-American male led the Miami-Dade police and the FBI along a trail of murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1994, a van driver was murdered and the vehicle and its cargo of nearly a million dollars went missing.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1995, a mother of three was murdered and her corpse burned in Los Angeles, California. Agents hunted down a charismatic man named Glen Rogers who used charm and generosity to target women for his brutal attacks.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1987, a television producer was gunned down in his New York office. Four years later and thousands of miles away, a man told Los Angeles police he had been hired to murder two Chippendale's dancers.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In New York, an armored car robbery left one guard dead and another critically wounded. The FBI suspected domestic terrorists with a history of violent crime. Their investigation led them to the Black Liberation Army and the Weather Underground.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1990, a California man's body was found dismembered. Six months later, the murder suspect was caught.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A teenager was shot to death on a hunting ground in Virginia. His death was initially considered an accident but investigators soon suspected foul play. Years later, a man contacted the FBI with a complex story of conspiracy and murder-for-hire.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1990, the body of a suspected drug courier was discovered burning in a Minnesota alleyway. The FBI teamed up with local police to uncover a dangerous crime ring run by a drug lord who used violence and intimidation to keep those around him quiet.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Drug gangs terrorized Harlem, New York neighborhoods for years in the early 1990s. After a 10-year-old boy became a crossfire victim, NYPD detectives and the FBI designed an elite task forced called C-11 to dismantle the gang.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A teenage immigrant came to the United States to realize her dream of being a doctor but she found herself an innocent victim of drug trafficking. Agents discovered a trail of drugs, hit men and murder as they attempted to solve her kidnapping.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The FBI discovered that the criminals had a hidden agenda beyond their personal wealth.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A cross-country crime spree over a Labor Day weekend terrorized the nation. In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and teenage boy disappeared within hours of one another. The police suspected the cases were linked.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S11 : E01 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A woman who inhaled toxic fumes now believes her neighbors want to kill her. A man is near death after an arrow pierces his chest and severs the wires to his pacemaker. Two women with swollen abdomens demand pain relief.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S11 : E02 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A circus sword swallower suffers from a persistent case of hiccups. A mother and daughter mysteriously collapse in the ER for completely different reasons. A woman loses control of her legs at her daughter's graduation.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S11 : E03 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: An ER doctor's friend arrives at the hospital combative and out of control, attacking the doctor and others in the ER. A cyclist's throat is torn open when a driver opens a car door in her path. A nursing student is found passed out.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S11 : E04 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A young girl, recently hit by a hockey puck, is now mysteriously paralyzed from the waist down. A young man complains of a splitting headache, but his motives seem suspicious. A bride-to-be has appendicitis.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S11 : E05 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: Doctors use a robot operated by a specialist at another hospital to treat a seizing 7-year-old boy. A chef's tongue is swelling. A woman who crashed her car insists her injured dog be treated first.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S11 : E06 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A surgeon requires urgent treatment after falling off a bed while trying to help his patient. A man with a slashed wrist has a secret. A woman gives birth to an intact amniotic sac, bewildering her doctor, and then announces she's having twins.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S11 : E07 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A young boy at a sleepover party mysteriously loses control of his arms and legs. A woman is shot in the leg at her own bachelorette party. Air bubbles in a woman's arteries are causing a stroke.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S11 : E08 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A knifing victim suddenly starts seizing and his doctors can't treat him until they figure out the cause.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S11 : E09 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A young woman in labor begs the ER doctor to keep her pregnancy and delivery a secret from her father.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S11 : E10 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A man is impaled in the abdomen by a stiletto heel. A seemingly healthy outdoorsman has a series of seizures, baffling his doctors. Two patients make their doctor suspicious when they both complain about identical headaches.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S12 : E01 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: Three patients sneak their pets into the hospital, causing pandemonium in the ER. A man experiences paralysis that rises from his legs to his lungs, gradually suffocating him. A war veteran suffers from phantom pain in his amputated hand.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S12 : E02 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A patient appears to be hallucinating and sends the ER staff on a wild-goose chase around the hospital.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S12 : E03 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A surfer is impaled between the legs by the fin of his surfboard. A high school football player has flesh-eating disease. A woman is given a powerful clot-busting drug to cure her stroke, but doctors discover she has another condition.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S12 : E04 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A live boa constrictor wrapped around a man's arm is biting his wrist and won't let go. A young woman has a sliced arm and doctors suspect she may be a victim of human trafficking. A young man with a peanut allergy goes into anaphylactic shock.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S12 : E05 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: An urgent care physician must invent creative ways to save a choking child and a man whose hand is covered in tar. A woman's pregnancy is a happy surprise, but complications threaten to overshadow the joyful news.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S12 : E06 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A woman's pregnancy is a shock to her husband and veers toward tragedy as eclampsia threatens both her life and their child's. A patient is brought to the ER with a live shark clamped onto his thigh - and he wants to save the shark!

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S12 : E07 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A violent patient faking a coma holds doctors and police hostage after stealing a policeman's gun. An ER doctor on her day off tries to save her cousin from a heart attack, but the cousin's boyfriend keeps getting in the way.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S12 : E08 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A fishing lure embedded in a man's face turns out to be the least of his problems. A pair of unconscious teenaged mud boggers are brought to the ER where dramatic family secrets are revealed during resuscitation. An ER tech collapses.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S12 : E09 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A man itching from poison oak exposure turns out to also have maggots burrowing into an injury on his back. A young woman has a bleeding lip, but doctors can't find the source of the bleed. Three car accident victims are admitted to the ER.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S12 : E10 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: Two car crash victims, a man and a woman, arrive separately and nearly naked. A boy suffering from nausea is found to have heart block that requires a pacemaker. A woman is so delusional that she throws syringes at the ER staff.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S13 : E01 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A teenage girl is impaled through the neck on an iron fence. A patient is convinced he's turning into a vampire. To save the life of an ill pregnant woman, a first-year attending physician has to stand up to a room full of senior specialists.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S13 : E02 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: The ER becomes a dangerous place when smuggled drugs are found in a patient's belly. A doctor is mystified by multiple heart attacks in one family. A rash on the body of a car crash victim leads a doctor to the mysterious cause of the accident.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S13 : E03 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: Two seemingly unrelated gunshot wounds lead to a bizarre night in the ER. A senior nurse unravels at the sight of a critical patient and reveals a shocking secret. A patient's grave symptoms mysteriously disappear whenever the doctor touches him.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S13 : E04 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A woman's thigh is impaled with a piece of rebar. A man brings his girlfriend into the ER for an STD workup.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S13 : E05 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: When a man with a hand injury passes out from abdominal pain, tests lead to a shocking discovery. The estranged daughter of a patient helps solve the mystery of his deadly symptoms. The ER is overrun with delirious Civil War reenactment soldiers.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S13 : E06 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A wrist fracture turns into a medical mystery. Two fishermen get stuck on the same lure. A cheerleader with a sprained finger nearly dies of an unexpected cause. A power outage in the hospital foils the ER team's efforts.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S13 : E07 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: The hospital is locked down when a nurse is shot in the ER. A bride is rushed in from her wedding with an unexplained altered mental status. Following a car accident, a doctor must perform a risky intervention to save the life of a teenage girl.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S13 : E08 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A teenage football player suffers a stroke in the ER. A renowned doctor recounts his first major trauma.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S13 : E09 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A doctor with a severe bee allergy is stung while treating a critical patient who's been stabbed in the eye. A man comes into the ER after slitting his own throat. A paramedic becomes a patient when she's suddenly struck down by a mysterious illness.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S13 : E10 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: An apparent drive-by shooting victim is missing his nose. A girl deteriorates before her family's eyes from a severe case of meningitis. A doctor's fight to save a suicidal patient is complicated by a snakebite victim who tries to have him arrested.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Didn't See It Coming
programme.desc: In this TV special, a man comes to the ER with a metal pipe stuck through his face and out his neck. A man lands on a shovel and it gets stuck in his perineum. Then, a heavy man has a knife lodged in his chest - only 1cm from his heart.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Worst Day Ever
programme.desc: In this TV special, two skydivers land on a metal post and a woman has a tie rod sticking out of her temple.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Nursing Intuition
programme.desc: In this TV special, a stroke patient's heart mysteriously stops, starts again and then stops. A nurse is in a predicament when the only available bed for a foul-mouthed woman is next to an elderly nun awaiting hip surgery.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Baby 911
programme.desc: In this TV special, parents bring in a young woman with stomach pain, but they don't know she is pregnant.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Secrets
programme.desc: In this TV special, an embarrassing secret prohibits a heart attack patient from being rushed to the ER for surgery. A man with a 5-hour erection gets caught between his wife and his mistress.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Temptations
programme.desc: In this TV special, a man comes into the ER with a surprising body part stuck inside a camping stove.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Party Fails
programme.desc: In this TV special, a group of frat boys arrives at the ER due to a "blue pee epidemic" and a bride with kidney stones refuses to remove her wedding gown.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Celebration Stoppers
programme.desc: In this TV special, a bridesmaid nearly drinks herself to death, a middle-aged man suffers from septic shock after indulging oysters on his anniversary and a birthday boy is rushed to the ER.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.: Nurse in Charge
programme.desc: In this TV special, a handsome geriatric patient surrounded by his many girlfriends shocks everyone, including the nurses, when he goes into life-threatening painkiller withdrawal.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Labor Pains
programme.desc: In this TV special, a doctor delivers a baby in a car and another one to parents unaware they were expecting!

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Creepy Crawlies
programme.desc: In this TV special, a doctor with a phobia of insects is approached with a sequence of insect-related ailments. A doctor thinks his coughing patient has asthma until she mentions something moving in her rectum.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Back from the Dead
programme.desc: In this TV special, a woman wakes up after a doctor has declared her deceased. An ER doctor is fading in and out of consciousness but is able to diagnose his own condition. A doctor treats a young heart attack victim.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Untold Stories of the ER

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER

programme.desc: A policewoman has been shot by a carjacker, a homeless woman has cellulitis, a drug dealer is unresponsive after being beaten, two middle-aged men have severe burns, and a man in his 70s has been found unresponsive.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A circus performer is bitten by a poisonous snake, a baby is delivered in a car park and more.

programme.desc: A patient who comes in after his hand has been chopped off by a lawnmower.

programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 Untold Stories of the ER

programme.desc: GLORY double champ Chico Kwasi (46-6-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world championship in the main event in a trilogy fight against top Bulgarian Teodor Hristov (20-5, 8 KO). A gigantic heavyweight clash takes place as former interim heavyweight champion Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (31-5-1, 17 KO) collides with the legend Errol ‘The Bonecrusher’ Zimmerman (112-21-1, 45 KO). Also happening at GLORY 109 are the Welterweight Proving Grounds. Several match-ups will take place where fighters aim to impress in order to put their names forward for the GLORY welterweight eight-man grand prix at the end of the year.

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: This video delves into the passionate and tumultuous journey of a small-town romance, capturing the essence of youthful love and heartbreak. The Giant Pig Smokehouse, a beloved local barbecue spot, serves as a backdrop for heartfelt conversations between friends and patrons who share their thoughts on love, loss, and moving forward. Owners Melissa and her brother opened the establishment in 2019, inspired by their love for smoked foods and Southern barbecue traditions. The video showcases their dedication to serving flavorful, family-style meals, emphasizing the importance of patience and love in their cooking. Viewers will hear from various patrons, each with their own story of love and heartache. From a couple reminiscing about their high school days to a person reflecting on a past relationship, the narratives highlight the universal themes of longing, regret, and the hope for new beginnings. The Giant Pig Smokehouse is more than just a restaurant; it’s a community hub where stories unfold and lives intersect. Whether it's the long lines for their famous pulled pork or the creation of a special menu item due to a customer's misreading, the video paints a vivid picture of a place that nurtures connections and memories. Join us as we explore how love, in all its forms, shapes the experiences of those who walk through its doors.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, an outlaw gang plans to take over the town by getting Judge Bean to resign over false charges of misconduct. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: In this epsiode, Storts and Hurley are holding hostage a doll that brings good luck to a Mexican village. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Custer's Last Stand
programme.desc: The survivor of an Indian attack acquires a rare medicine arrow, and a menacing character named Blade (Reed Howes) will stop at nothing to take it from him. Elmer Clifton (Assassin of Youth, Seven Doors to Death) directs a memorable cast that includes Rex Lease (The Sign of the Wolf, The Monster Walks), Lona Andre (Slaves in Bondage, Death in the Air), and William Farnum (Samson and Delilah). Meanwhile, Frank McGlynn Jr is in the title role of General George A. Custer.

programme.title: Northwest Trail
programme.desc: Mountie Matt OBrien assignment is simple: He is to escort the rather grouchy, and slightly annoying, Miss Katherine Owens to a remote outpost. Things complicate however when they arrive at the outpost and he stumbles upon an illegal mining operation. Stars include Bob Steele, Joan Woodbury, and Poodles Hanneford.

programme.title: Winds of the Wasteland
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this Republic Pictures western about the final days of the Pony Express. Former rider John Blair (Wayne) enters a coach race to win a $25,000 government mail contract, but there are dozens of obstacles in his path. The rest of the cast includes Lane Chandler and Phyllis Fraser, plus Lew Kelly (Lady of Burlesque) doing a great comic turn as Rocky OBrien, the eccentric, self-proclaimed mayor of a deserted mining town.

programme.title: Doomed Caravan
programme.desc: Hoppy is enlisted to help protect Jane Travers' next caravan against robbers who have been terrorizing travelers. He comes across a wily pair of thieves who hve their men disguised as soldiers to escort the caravan. Hoppy isn't fooled for a second and busts up their plan with help from the Bar 20 boys. Not to be outdone, the thieves then capture everyone but Hoppy and puts them before a firing squad. Not it's up to Hoppy to rescue his friends singlehandedly. The cast includes William Boyd as Hopalong Cassidy, with Russell Hayden and Andy Clyde as Luky Jenkins and California Jack. For those counting, this was the 32nd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. They would be edited for syndication on television, bringing Hoppy and his friends to a whole new generation of fans.

programme.title: Ghost Town Gold [The Three Mesquiteers]
programme.desc: CAVALIERS OF THE CACTUS COUNTRY--ALWAYS READY FOR A FIGHT OR A FROLICK! The second entry in what would grow into a wildly popular series of Western Three Mesquiteers B-Movies produced by Republic Pictures, Ghost Town Gold tracks the titular trio as they attempt to recover the gold stolen by a gang in its effort to ruin the bank/mayor who ordered them to leave town. Frequent John Wayne collaborator Joseph Kane adds his signature directorial panache to this rousing shoot-em-up, setting the tone for a film series that was so rampantly successful, it spawned 50 sequels and a host of imitators from rival studios.

programme.title: Courageous Avenger
programme.desc: Gold, gangs, and the heroic fight for life! Johnny Mack Brown (Billy the Kid, Coquette) stars in this western thriller about murders going on in a mining community. Its a story full of twists, where the greed for gold is only surpassed by the struggle for life!

programme.title: Outpost In Morocco
programme.desc: George Raft, Mary Windsor, and Akim Tamiroff star in this romantic drama from director Robert Florey (The Florentine Dagger, Daughter of Shanghai). Raft plays Capt. Gerard, a member of the Foreign Legion known for his romantic entanglements. He's assigned to escort an emir's daughter to her father's mountain citadel and learn about the emir's activities. Not surprisingly, Gerard finds trouble brewing! With footage shot in Morocco, this movie also features a beautiful musical score by twotime Oscar nominee Michel Michelet (Voice in the Wind).

programme.title: Between Men
programme.desc: When his young son is shot, John Wellington kills the culprit and flees. But his son Johnny recovers and is raised by Sir George. Some twenty years later Johnny sets out to find Sir George's missing granddaughter. He finds her and also finds Rand, but neither of the two men realize they are father and son.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers appeared in several Republic Pictures during the 1930s, and this is considered one of their best. It's about a mysterious murder at an archeological expedition, which leads the three prairie pals into some dangerous territory. Can they solve the murder without losing their own lives? The cast includes Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, and Roger Williams, all trying to survive a hail of poison arrows and hot lead!

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: Stagecoach to Denver
programme.desc: Ride the outlaws' highway! Allan Rocky Lane stars as Red Ryder, shootin' and fightin' his way to justice in this old slugfest from Republic Pictures. programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: Law of the Pampas
programme.desc: Murder below the Equator...and Hopalong Cassidy races to action in the heart of the wild Pampas country !Hoppy (William Boyd) and his pal Lucky (Russell Hayden) head to South America to look after a herd of cattle sold by Cassidy's boss to an Argentine rancher. Unfortunately, the scoundrel Ralph Merritt (Sidney Blackmer) wants the cattle, and he's not above hiring some dangerous characters to do his dirty work. It's a test of blazing guns...under a blazing sun! Can the boys of Bar 20 lay down the law in a lawless place like the Pampas? Can Hoppy and his gang succeed in what is truly a last frontier? Watch and see!

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ben and Adam are in jail, about to be hung for a crime they didn't commit. Joe and Hoss must find out why the witnesses to the alleged crime have lied about what happened before the execution takes place. They receive help from a vagrant named Lassiter who is looking for the men who committed a lynching in Kansas years ago.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The son of a neighboring rancher intends to sell their land for a mining operation that will ruin the water rights agreement that Andy and Ben made years ago. Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The Cartwrights take a young boy to the Ponderosa after the death of his mother. Hoss is the only one that is able to get through the boy's hostility and bitterness, but, as the two begin to get close, the boy's father breaks out of prison and comes to retrieve the boy.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Little Joe Cartwright tries to help a gypsy girl who was abandoned by her people - because they believed she was a werewolf.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Yodelin' Kid from Pine Ridge
programme.desc: Cowboy icon Gene Autry is framed for murder in this tale of warring cattlemen and turpentiners. The music driven western from director Joseph Kane (Flame of Barbary Coast) includes such familiar faces as Smiley Burnette, Charles Middleton, and Betty Bronson. In between gunshots you'll hear plenty of traditional cowboy songs, including She'll Be Coming 'Round The Mountain, and Red River Valley, plus Gene's version of Sing Me a Song of the Saddle.

programme.title: Frontier Justice
programme.desc: Hoot Gibson is back! But he never imagined he'd find his father in an insane asylum and his cattle ranch overrun with sheep! Worst of all, Roger Williams stars as the diabolical James WIlton, a rival who isn't above murder. For trivia buffs: Director Robert F. McGowan was the man behind several of the classic Our Gang comedies...

programme.title: Young Buffalo Bill
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars in this highly fictionalized account of Bill Cody's life from director Joseph Kane (Dakota, Flame of Barbary Coast). What it lacks in accuracy is made up for with adventure, as well as and some of Roy's great cowboy songs, including 'Blow Breeze Blow', and 'Rollin' Down to Santa Fe'. Other stars include George 'Gabby' Hayes, Chief Thundercloud, and the lovely Pauline Moore (Young Mr. Lincoln, Charlie Chan at Treasure Island)

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: A big time cast, including Randolph Scott, Buster Crabbe, Barton MacLane, and Harry Carey star in this feature about stampedes, Indian attacks, and plundering thieves! Directed by the esteemed Henry Hathaway (True Grit, Niagara).

programme.title: Captain Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of his henchmen deliver guns across the border to a corrupt Mexican general who is bent on overtaking the province by force. When Griffin then demands that the general now fulfill his part of the bargain, the general orders him killed, unaware that his lieutenant, Sanchez is in Griffins employ. Rather than killing Griffin, Sanchez shoots the general, and after promoting himself to the post, promises Griffin that he will cross the border in time for April Morning. When O.J. is found murdered, Apache questions Maude, who reveals that O.J. traveled to a Mexican cantina monthly. Apache then rides to the cantina, where he is met by a cavalry patrol led by Sgt. ORourke. Upon learning that the cantina owner has recently been killed, Apache demands that the mans widow, Rosita, take him to Rodriguez, her husbands employer. Rosita then introduces Apache to a Mexican sergeant who allegedly knows where Rodriguez can be found. Unaware that the sergeant is Rodriguez disguised as a soldier, Apache follows him to a church where the priest claims that Rodriguez has claimed sanctuary and is therefore immune to the law.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: John Wayne stars as Ted Hayden, a tough hombre who goes undercover to join a gang led by a heartless fiend known only as Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock). Gentry is out to take over a ranch belonging to one of Hayden's friends, but as Hayden finds out, Gentry has a lot more than that up his sleeve. You'll have to watch this two-fisted Western to find out the rest!

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: Lost Canyon
programme.desc: When Johnny Travers (Jay Kirby) is falsely accused of robbing a bank, it's up to Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) to clear his name and find the real villains. There's nothing better than watching Hoppy get rough with the rustlers, and it's all the better when you get to hear the Sportsmen Quartette sing (I got Spurs) Jingle, Jangle, Jingle.

programme.title: The Kansan
programme.desc: Richard Dix stars in this epic of the boisterous and brawling Old West! Wounded in a gun battle with the notorious James gang, John Bonniwell (Dix) wakes up in the hospital to find out hes been elected marshal! He quickly learns that this hot-headed frontier town can only be cooled off with blazing lead and dynamite! Jane Wyatt, Albert Dekker, Victor Jory, and Robert Armstrong also star in this tale of smashing fists and crashing bullets from director George Archainbaud (The Lost Squadron).

programme.title: Bulldog Courage
programme.desc: Tim McCoy, one of the unsung heroes of 1930s western pictures, stars in a dual role. First, hes Slim Braddock, a miner who turns to robbing stagecoaches after being swindled by a banker. When Slim is murdered, his son Tim, also played by McCoy, seeks vengeance. Directed by B-movie legend Sam Newfield for Excelsior Pictures, this film is a showcase for McCoy, who appeared in more than 90 movies and in 1960 earned a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame!

programme.title: Red Ryder: Roll, Thunder, Roll!
programme.desc: Red Ryder finds two silver conchas, the trademark of bandit El Conejo, at a raided ranch. He reports the raid to Marshal Bill Faugh but tells him that he suspects that El Conejo, a Robin Hood type character, is being framed.

programme.title: Hit the Saddle
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers get involved when a local sheriff is killed in this B-western from Republic Pictures. The trouble starts when a villainous rancher (J.P. McGowan) plots to steal some government protected horses. Bob Livingstone, Max Terhune, and Ray Corrigan star as the gallant Mesquiteers, while a young Rita Hayworth (Gilda, The Lady From Shanghai) appears as a sexy saloon singer who turns a Mesquiteer's head.

programme.title: Hellgate (Edited Version)
programme.desc: In 1867 Kansas, veterinarian Sterling Hayden treats an injured stranger who turns out to have been a guerrilla raider--and Hayden soon finds himself serving a term in one of the world's most terrifying prisons under sadistic commandant Ward Bond. Adapted from the story of Dr. Mudd, the physician who attended John Wilkes Booth, assassin of President Lincoln.

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: Way of the West
programme.desc: Government agent Gordon (Hal Taliaferro) goes undercover to investigate an ongoing war between cattlemen and sheepmen. But he soon finds himself framed for murder! This low budget western from the short-lived Empire Pictures is from the golden era of shoot em ups, when audiences knew who the bad guys were, and couldnt wait for the good guys to serve up some just punishment!

programme.title: Mohawk
programme.desc: Kurt Neumann (The Fly, Rocketship X-M) directed this bawdy tale of a love that was louder than war drums! With a cast that includes Scott Brady, Rita Gam, and Neville Brand, the story takes place on a remote army post where an artist romances a trio of women, just as a vengeful settler turns the army and the local Iroquois tribe against each other. Film buffs might like to know that the cinematography for this feature is by four-time Oscar nominee Karl Struss, who won an Academy Award in 1929 for his work on Sunrise.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: He likes his whiskey hard... His women soft... And his west all to himself! Inspired by Shakespeares The Taming of the Shrew (1594), John Wayne (The Searchers, Stagecoach), Maureen OHara (Miracle on 34th Street, The Parent Trap), and Patrick Wayne (The Searchers, The Alamo) star in this western comedy directed by Andrew V. McLaglen (Gunsmoke, The Wild Geese). George Washington McLintock (John Wayne) is the wealthiest man in his territory who utilizes his power and influence to maintain order between farmers, ranchers, Indians, corrupt government officials, and his own family! McLintock is McNificent!

programme.sub-title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Solutions to atrocious crimes can hinge on the smallest clues. Even with advanced technology, vision remains an important tool.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: There's an old saying that a burden shared is a burden halved. But when people team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder but some killers are especially cruel, choosing their victims at random or with no apparent motive and then expertly covering their tracks.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The great outdoors may offer clues to solving heinous crimes. Seed germination and the presence of certain insects provide vital information about murders.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest murder weapon and poisoners are sometimes the most brutal killers, harming their victims over time to disguise the murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Forensic investigators must go to great lengths to catch the killer when the victim is only presumed dead.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other or marriages fail, some coldblooded spouses find a gruesome way to gain an uncontested divorce: murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: There's no statute of limitations on murder, so as a case turns cold and clues become scarce, investigators must rely on modern forensic technology to solve the crimes and catch the killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to science to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Some people murder for love, others murder out of hatred. But sometimes people kill for the money.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: For some killers, once is never enough. Often, cold and calculated serial killings are more difficult to solve than violent crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack, agents of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives can be called in to help.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Sometimes arson fires are set to cover a different, more heinous crime, such as murder. But killers are wrong to think that fire destroys all vital clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Often, the witnesses of a crime are also the main suspects. They're able to manipulate the truth to throw off the authorities.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at the scene of the crime. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes can pinpoint where the crime occurred.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who eventually find their way home, but others simply disappear without a trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A sniper is brought to justice through ballistic tests; a bloody hand print leads to a suspect in a double homicide; a semen sample is tied to gunman.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of family and marriage.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Investigators study small clues left at the crime scene, such as a paint chip, saliva from a cigarette and glass fragments.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death and is often interpreted as a heart attack or underlying health issue.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder, at least for a while. Thrilled by their success, they tend to kill again and again.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the only clues to the killer come from the victim.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in an investigation but when a killer destroys the body, even the best medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate death's time frame.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances and fires: they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's job.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and over time water can destroy the few clues the killer may have left behind.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Some dogs have been trained by law enforcement to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives and missing persons.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time when they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer who murders to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When a killer turns a gun on a victim, ballistic analysis is key to cracking the case. Each shot fired leaves behind its own clues, allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes lethal.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Sometimes, seemingly small and insignificant clues, such as three hairs, microscopic fibers or a paint chip, become a victim's silent witness and help solve even the most baffling cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is a vital key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print or even the shape of a bruise can help investigators track down murderers.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology, the examination of dental evidence, to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two ruthless killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The law enforcement agency of the Navy and Marine Corps uses forensic science to solve perplexing murders.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use modern technology and advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the murders of three women who were killed by men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The elements of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Combining art and science, forensic anthropologists can give victims a face long after they've been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Sometimes, the wrong people are punished for crimes they did not commit. Forensic scientists use DNA analysis to overturn convictions of these innocent men and women who have spent years behind bars.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers go missing on the Appalachian Trail. A grandmother never returns home from work.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A millionaire is murdered for a stash of buried treasure. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, insects that nest in corpses are like witnesses to the crime. By studying their behavior, scientists learn everything.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Photography has long been a fundamental tool in homicide investigations. A single image can hold enough information to identify a suspect.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are not the only ones to suffer from their violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Philadelphia's Vidocq Society is one of the world's most unusual crime-solving organizations: a members-only club made up of forensic professionals.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a lucrative business. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must dig deep and go beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When an untraceable poison is used as a murder weapon, investigators rely on forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental, forensics can reveal the deception just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When everyday substances reveal clues that break a case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Most victims are meticulously chosen by their murderer because of a connection or because they match a set of criteria.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Killers often will try to cover up their crime by hiding the remains of their victims. Sometimes bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When a victim is killed at point-blank range, police often suspect that a friend or acquaintance is to blame, because for a stranger it would otherwise prove too difficult.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: In most murder cases, police rely on motive to pursue a killer. But when the murderer is a stranger, the crime may go unsolved for years.

programme.title: Find Her & Marry Her
programme.desc: When Kennedy's friend advices him to stay away from "city girls", he throws away his relationship to meet a girl from the village, but soon finds himself in over his head.

programme.title: The Missing Package
programme.desc: In The Missing Package, Detective Lazarus is almost done for the day when an unassuming middle-aged man walks in and reports a package he is expecting missing, but more importantly is the carrier who seems to have disappeared into thin air. This sets Detective Lazarus on a wild goose chase to find what appears to be a package determined not to be found and a carrier who appears to no longer exist.

programme.title: MTV Shuga Mashariki Ep 5
programme.desc: Asha organizes a slut march to end victim shaming but her announcement is met with some negative reviews by Nyokabi and the Rachel’s who think it’s vulgarity doesn’t help the cause. Meanwhile Nyokabi suspects Salaton is having sex with Asha, which leads her to confront Asha.

programme.title: MTV Shuga Mashariki Ep 6
programme.desc: Nyokabi and Salaton ﬁnally have their great reckoning, and maybe it was worth the wait. Meanwhile Odek ﬁnds himself in unfamiliar territory, catching feelings for Wendo, but maybe she’s catching feelings too. Asha crashes down from her protest high when she’s silenced, but a Queen will always rise- and why have the looks if you won’t use them?

programme.title: Meet The Surrogate Mum
programme.desc: What started off as a remedy for bearing children becomes a redemption from a loveless and worrisome marriage.

programme.title: AMC Movie Talk S7 - Chuks Joseph
programme.desc: Join us every week on the AMC couch as we talk to the biggest movers and shakers in the buzzing industry. We are putting you in the know with all things in African and Nollywood cinema actors, actresses, directors, producers, classic cinema and soon to be blockbuster hits it's all here on AMC Movie Talk.

programme.title: Uptight
programme.desc: Sonia's temper pushes everyone away from her, leaving her unlucky in love. She finally meets Leon, who is patient and wants to be with her, but her erratic behaviour leaves him questioning his decision.

programme.title: His Mystery Lover
programme.desc: Bryan's indecision between two women costs him true love, leaving him unable to commit and ultimately missing out on a genuine connection.

programme.title: Two Weeks Later
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Plagued with loving and hating her boss, Rachel resigns from work to start a life but two weeks later, everything changes as her boss comes calling with an offer she has only imagined in her dreams.

programme.title: All I Ask
programme.desc: Mrs Eugene goes from thinking she is in a happy marriage to finding out her husband is having an affair, while battling life-threatning illness. Will she put her family back together on time?

programme.title: Road To My Heart
programme.desc: Nothing beats the force of love as Josephine finds her way to Justine's heart and softens the hard shell around it.

programme.title: Meet Me Halfway
programme.desc: A young flamboyant man realizes he might be losing control of his inheritance, and being married to a woman he despises may just be more than a solution.

programme.title: The Missing Girl
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Pedro, a dedicated software developer in search of love, meets Kaka through a dating app. Their connection is electric, but when Kaka disappears, Pedro's world turns dark. As he rushes to find her, Pedro uncovers mysteries that cast suspicion on him. His own past adds to the intrigue. Determined to clear his name, Pedro delves into a desperate search, revealing shocking secrets.

programme.title: Mr Nice Guy
programme.desc: Fiona is shocked by her friend, Isabel’s cold reaction to her long-distance boyfriend Tyler coming back to town. Meanwhile, Isabel thinks Fiona’s obsession with her relationship is starting to cross the line.

programme.title: In Bloom - Mare
programme.desc: A collection of 5 short films addressing gender equality issues such as period poverty, child marriage, gender-based violence, HIV and economic empowerment. Third Short: "Maré", written and directed by Giuliana Monteiro (Brazil). A mother on the edge of her sanity seeks solace from a tumultuous life situation.

programme.title: AMC Music Lounge S7 - Dotti The Deity
programme.desc: AMC Music Lounge returns for its seventh season bringing you some new interviews, new live performances, fun musical games, and many more from legendary and emerging artistes.

programme.title: Loving A Con Man
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Zed, who goes by many names, is a perfect con man, making women fall for him and taking their money. Things start to change when he meets Tabitha, a successful novelist with a fiancé abroad. Zed believes she is the perfect victim for a con until he starts to fall for her.

programme.title: Life As A Single Mom Ep9
programme.desc: Having terminated two pregnancies for Lanre, Grace refuses to abort a third pregnancy for the man she has devoted her best years to, especially when she believes they are destined to get married. But everything takes a devastating turn when Lanre gives her an ultimatum: choose between him and their unborn child. When Grace chooses her baby, Lanre breaks his promise of marriage, leaving her to face an uncertain future alone.

programme.title: Life As A Single Mom Ep10
programme.desc: Having terminated two pregnancies for Lanre, Grace refuses to abort a third pregnancy for the man she has devoted her best years to, especially when she believes they are destined to get married. programme.title: Cover Story
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Caught in a web of lies, a private investigator's pursuit of truth takes a dangerous turn when he's offered a deal to change the cover story in a high-stakes game of deception and betrayal.

programme.title: Swap Identity
programme.desc: A woman lets a close friend into her home, not realising that she is jeopardising her relationship.

programme.title: Married To The Enemy
programme.desc: Feyi's resentments of his wife, Prisca's successful career results in him belittling her every chance he gets. Things get worse when she falls pregnant and she decides enough is enough.

programme.title: Barren Hope
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A man’s well-ordered life is thrown into turmoil when he is named the sole beneficiary of his deceased Aunt’s inheritance. His girlfriend and his dependent cousin engage in a “mortal combat” to determine who should be closest to him.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Crown
programme.desc: Lolade, a gifted shoemaker living under her aunt’s harsh rules, secretly builds her dream brand. After accidentally attacking a disguised Prince Ayoola, she later discovers his true identity, and that her fate is in his hands, when she pitches her designs at a village funding event.

programme.title: Abigail's Memoir
programme.desc: Abigail finds solace and love in her tight-knit family, comprised of her father and beloved brother. However, their lives take a dramatic turn when her father falls for a mysterious woman driven solely by financial motives.

programme.title: Loophole
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A young lady enjoys the marital bliss of her home until she is faced with opposing forces that leads to destructive secrets. She is left with the options, flight or fight.

programme.title: Too Late
programme.desc: A man constantly cheats on his girlfriend with no remorse, believing she will always forgive him and take him back, until one day he takes things too far and she decides to move on. He does all he can to get her back but is it too late?

programme.title: Green
programme.desc: After years of being alone, believing they have missed out on love, two people, who are old in years but young at heart, find each other.

programme.title: One Crazy Day
programme.desc: An airport luggage mix-up causes a chance meeting between Pamela and Lawrence, which leads to connections and consequences that changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Fashion Insider - Vine Olugo
programme.desc: Discover new designers, trends, styles, and more at Fashion Insider. Elileojo Achebo provides you with the opportunity to gain firsthand knowledge of the African stylists of the moment.

programme.title: Legal Love
programme.desc: A lawyer and a company owner's son navigate a complex relationship, initially marked by tension. Their connection unexpectedly deepens, while a hidden agenda threatens their burgeoning romance.

programme.title: Along Came Love
programme.desc: Worried that some illegalities are going on in her father’s company, a lady goes undercover to investigate and uncover the truth and finds herself in an entanglement she didn’t see coming.

programme.title: MTV Shuga Mashariki Ep 7
programme.desc: Kabi faces a pregnancy scare, Wendo deals with an STI, and Asha speaks out during the pageant.

programme.title: MTV Shuga Mashariki Ep 8
programme.desc: Wendo and Odek start dating, just as Nyokabi and Salaton face the truth. Asha considers quitting Uni, just as Hanifa’s granny dies. Eric abducts Dada and Neelai’s is kidnapped by a sex trafficking ring.

programme.title: Everybody Business
programme.desc: Tired of her brother constantly sab otaging her relationships, Stella decides to find something to keep him busy but her plans backfires.

programme.title: Newly Singles
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Hilda and Obinna instantly bond over the fact that they were both dumped unexpectedly by their respective partners, on the same weekend. Their commiseration turns into a mission when they see that their exes have happily moved on to new romances via social media. Desperate to win their loves back, they hatch up a plan to put an end to their exes' new relationships and send them running back to their arms.

WSOFNYC featured an unprecedented New Years Eve world championship extravaganza at The Theater at Madison Square Garden in New York City.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Full Fight: Gaethje v. Guillard

programme.title: Full Fights: Justin Gaethje

programme.title: Full Fights: Justin Gaethje
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Full Fight: Gaethje v. Newell

programme.title: Full Fights: Justin Gaethje
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Full Fight: Gaethje v. Palomino 1

programme.title: Full Fights: Justin Gaethje
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Full Fight: Gaethje v. Palomino 2
programme.desc: In a rematch of one of the best fights in WSOF history, undefeated lightweight champ Justin Gaethje (14-0) attempts to defend his belt against Luis Palomino (23-10) for the second time. Gaethje vs Palomino 2 in the main event of WSOF 23, 2015.
